title: Slay the Spire
notes: Window capture, hover, click and drag validated on Ubuntu Wayland/XWayland. XTest did not deliver button events on the validation host.
introduction: Slay the Spire is a single-player deck-building roguelike. You play the Ironclad on Ascension 10 and climb three acts of a branching map, choosing rooms (ordinary fights, elites, rest sites, shops, events, treasure). Fights are turn based: each turn you get energy and a hand of cards, play attacks and blocks against enemies whose next move is shown above them, then end the turn. After fights you add cards, relics and potions. Each act ends with a boss on floor 16, 33 and 50; dying ends the run. The run starts on floor 1 of a fixed-seed Ascension 10 run, right after the opening fight, with 72 of 80 HP and the Ascender's Bane curse in the deck.
controls: Mouse only for almost everything: click a card then click or drag it onto a target, click map nodes to travel, click rewards and buttons. Hovering shows card and relic details. E ends the turn. Escape opens or closes menus and overlays.
